meta.title: Ohana
meta.description: One app for the whole family: calendar, finance, meals, doctor appointments and an assistant.

roles.editorHint: can change everything and add people

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.soon: The assistant will look things up, plan and change things in every part of Ohana. It arrives with the calendar and the finances.

modules.calendar: Vacation, public holidays, sick days and day-care closures, with a coverage check and a calendar feed.
modules.finance: Transactions, accounts, categories, bank statement import and monthly overviews.
modules.meals: Recipes, meal plans that share ingredients, shopping lists and a cooking view.
modules.appointments: Watches Doctolib and jameda and tells you when an appointment frees up.
modules.soonText: This part of Ohana isn't there yet. Until then, keep using the app you use today.

home.intro: Everything your family plans, in one place.
home.noFamilyText: Create a family, or ask someone to add you to theirs (with the email of your account) or to send you an invite link.

admin.familiesHint: Being an administrator doesn't open a family: add yourself as a member for that.
admin.deleteFamilyConfirm: Delete {{family}} with everything in it? This can't be undone.

types.title: Entry types
types.yearNote: These types belong to {{year}} – every year has its own. Changes are saved immediately.
types.copyFromTitle: Start {{to}} with the types of {{from}}; you can change them afterwards
types.copyOtherHint: Adds the types of that year that {{year}} doesn't have yet.
types.helpNeeds: Needs cover – e.g. “Day care closed”. A weekday with this entry and nothing that covers it is flagged as a gap.
types.helpCovers: Covers – e.g. “Vacation Dad”. Covers a “needs cover” day.
types.helpDayOff: Day off – e.g. “Holiday”. Covers everything and doesn't count as a used vacation day.
types.helpNone: Normal – just a color, no coverage logic.
types.name: Name
types.confirmDeleteUsed: Delete “{{name}}”? It is used on {{days}} in {{year}}. This can't be undone.
types.readonly: Only editors of the family can change entry types.

note.title: Icon & note
note.replaceHint: The selected days have different notes – saving replaces them.

help.title: How the calendar works
help.tapDo: Select a day; tap another day to move the selection
help.rangeDo: Tap a start day, then “Range”, then the end day
help.multiDo: Turn it on, then tap days to add or remove them; long-press + drag adds a range
help.clickDo: Select a day / a range of days (across months)
help.ctrlDo: Add single days to the selection
help.typeDo: Toggle that entry on the selected days (a day can have several)
help.copyDo: Copy / cut / paste. Pasting onto a larger selection repeats the copied days to fill it.
help.handleDo: Repeat the selected days forwards or backwards
help.noteDo: Add an icon or comment to the selected days
help.zoomDo: Zoom the calendar in / out (fewer or more days at once) / reset
help.gapDo: Jump to the next day that still needs cover
help.question: <kbd>?</kbd>

view.title: Calendar view
view.weekdaysTitle: Show the weekday letters on the days at every zoom level
view.skipWeekendsTitle: Weekends are left out when filling, pasting or toggling ranges

feed.title: Calendar subscription
feed.help: The only link that works without signing in: it opens the calendar feed, nothing else.
feed.icloudHelp: A read-only calendar feed. Apple Calendar checks it for changes regularly (choose “Every hour” or “Every 5 minutes” when subscribing on a Mac).
feed.rotateConfirm: Make a new feed address? Calendar subscriptions with the current one stop updating and need to be added again.
feed.howto: How to add it to iCloud
feed.howtoIos: iPhone / iPad: tap “Subscribe on this device” above (or Settings → Apps → Calendar → Calendar Accounts → Add Account → Other → Add Subscribed Calendar, and paste the URL).
feed.howtoMac: Mac: Calendar → File → New Calendar Subscription…, paste the URL, set Location to iCloud so it syncs to all your devices, and pick an auto-refresh interval.
feed.howtoSync: A subscription stored in iCloud (Mac, Location “iCloud”) appears on all your Apple devices and on iCloud.com.
feed.legacyHelp: The feed address of this family in family-planner. Its event ids live on, so subscriptions moved over keep their events.
feed.legacyConfirm: Remove the old calendar link? Calendar subscriptions made with it stop updating.

overview.nothing: Nothing planned for the next weeks.

finance.categoriesHelp: Used to sort transactions. Income categories show for money coming in, expense categories for money going out, “both” for either. Categories can have subcategories, as deep as you like: a subcategory has the kind of its top category, and a category's totals include its subcategories.
finance.empty: No transactions in this period. Add one or import a bank statement (CSV).
finance.noData: No transactions in this period yet.
finance.readonly: You can look at the finances, but only editors can change them.
finance.name: Name

compare.title: Comparison
compare.deltaHint: Ø = average of the completed months. The percentages show how “{{first}}” differs from each column.

benchmark.title: Statistic average
benchmark.help: Figures the overview shows your months against, e.g. the household spending of a statistics office. Each amount is a range per month in {{currency}}, from the lower to the upper households; one end alone is a single average. Leave out what you don't know. Not set, the overview doesn't show it.
benchmark.label: Source
benchmark.labelPlaceholder: e.g. Federal Statistical Office 2024, couple with 2 children
benchmark.invalid: Amounts must be numbers of at least 0, “from” not above “to”.

finance.categoryDeleteConfirm:
Delete the category “{{name}}”?

Its transactions stay, without a category. Its subcategories move up to the top level.
finance.subcategoryDeleteConfirm:
Delete the category “{{name}}”?

Its transactions and subcategories move to “{{parent}}”.
finance.mappingsHelp: How the columns of a bank's CSV files map, remembered by their header row. Remove one to set it up again on the next import.
finance.noMappings: None yet: the import remembers the format of a bank's files.
finance.clearHelp: Deletes all transactions, accounts, categories and saved bank formats of this family and resets the currency. The calendar stays as it is.
finance.clearConfirm:
Delete all finance data?

All transactions, accounts, categories and saved bank formats are deleted for everyone in this family. This can't be undone — export the family first if you might need them again.

import.title: Import a bank statement
import.help: Export the transactions from your online banking as a CSV file and pick it here. Rows that were imported before are skipped.
import.skipped_one: {{count}} row without a date or amount – skipped
import.skipped_other: {{count}} rows without a date or amount – skipped
import.remember: Remember this format for the next statement
import.autoTransfers: Combine transfers and split bookings automatically

finance.importedNone: Nothing new: all {{n}} were already there
finance.accountsHelp: Your bank accounts, cash or cards. A transaction can belong to one; the balance is the opening balance plus all of its transactions.
finance.accountDeleteConfirm:
Delete the account “{{name}}”?

All its transactions are deleted too. This can't be undone.
finance.transferAmountHint: Part of a transfer: it counts only once, as the sum of its bookings
finance.combineZero: Adds up to 0: it won't count as income or expense.
finance.combineIncome: It will count once, as {{amount}} of income.
finance.combineExpense: It will count once, as {{amount}} of expenses.
finance.findTransfersHelp: The same amount leaving one of your accounts and arriving in another within a few days. Combined, the two count as nothing: the money stayed in the family.
finance.noSuggestions: No likely transfers in this period. A transfer is the same amount going out of one account and into another, at most 4 days apart.
finance.autoCombineHelp: Combine every split booking with its parts (e.g. an order's items, also booked one by one) and every likely transfer between your accounts in this period, without a review
finance.nothingToCombine: No transfers or split bookings found
finance.splitAmountHint: Split booking: it counts only through its parts and what they leave over
finance.combineSplitHelp: {{name}} ({{amount}}) becomes the booking, the others its parts: they count on their own, the booking only with what they leave over
finance.combineSplitBlocked: Only transactions that aren't in a transfer or a split booking yet can be combined
finance.combineTransferBlocked: Parts and split bookings can't be in a transfer
finance.unsplitPart: Take out of the split booking
finance.unsplitPartDone: Taken out of the split booking
